Name: SchoolAccountStatementBatchIdentifier
Valid Content: Batch Type = AS, Cycle Indicator, SchoolCode = X00000-X99999,Batch Date, Batch Time

Name: DirectLoanSchoolCode
Valid Content: Direct Loan School Code, X00000-X99999 where X = G or E

Name: RegionCode
Valid Content: 2 digit region code of the school, 01-99

Name: StateCode
Valid Content: 2 letter state code of the school, Uppercase, can be blank

Name: EndDate
Valid Content: CCYYMMDD, end of the current statement period, this statement represents activity up to and through this date only

Name: ProcessDate
Valid Content: CCYYMMDD, Date report processed at COD

Name: AwardIdentifier
Valid Content: Created at the time of origination, <SSN><Loan Type Code><2 digit program year><school code><Lean sequence number 001-999>

Name: LoanBookedDate
Valid Content: CCYYMMDD, may be blank if loan is not booked

Name: DisbursementBookedDate
Valid Content: CCYYMMDD, may be blank if the loan is not booked

Name: RecordCountSequenceNumber
Valid Content: Record counter for each record in the SAS file, 000001-999999
